gauge.name: Cache La Poudre River (CO) at Greeley

impacts.statement: Extensive inundation of structures occurs along the Cache la Poudre River in and west of Greeley.
Most roads crossing the Cache la Poudre River are impassable. Water floods the sewage treatment plant and Island Grove Park in northeast Greeley.
Numerous houses and businesses along the Cache la Poudre River flood in northeast Greeley. There is also extensive flooding of roads crossing the river.
Multiple streets and roads crossing the Cache la Poudre River flood in and west of Greeley, including 85th Avenue.
The Cache la Poudre River floods 71st Avenue in northern Greeley. Lowland and trail flooding occurs along the river from Windsor through Greeley.
Sections of the Poudre River Trail begin to overtop from Windsor to Greeley.
There is minor overbank flow into low lying areas along the Cache la Poudre River between Windsor and Greeley.

hydronotes.statement: Stage may be affected by ice during winter months.

gauge.forecastReliability: Forecasts are not available. Only observed stages are available for this point.
